short_summary: Do not send: the Spanish reverses the meaning and says the order was cancelled.
suggested_correction: Buenas noticias: su pedido ha sido enviado y llegará pronto.
back_translation: Your order was cancelled and will not be shipped.
explanation: The Spanish translation completely reverses the meaning of the original message, falsely telling the customer their order was cancelled and will not be shipped, when in fact it has already shipped. Sending this would cause serious customer confusion and potential business harm.
